newsitem.title: USA: PECO sees Limerick nuke restart over weekend.
newsitem.headline: PECO sees Limerick nuke restart over weekend.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,055 megawatt (MW) Limerick 2 nuclear power plant, shut late Wednesday, is expected to restart this weekend, the company said Thursday.
"We have to repair a leaking seal. We should be back up sometime over the weekend," a company spokesman said.
The unit, in Pottstown, Pa., was operating at about 40 percent power at the time of the shutdown, he said.
This past weekend an air leak was detected in the condenser, which forced operators to reduce power at the unit.
The adjacent unit, with an identical generating capacity, is operating at full power.
